summary: Register Magnit Market as a read-only marketplace provider using the current official Partner API for shop-scoped SKU catalog, exact prices, explicit aggregate stock-type inventory and bounded FBS order reads with no marketplace writes.

impacts.evidence: Shop/stock-type/order-window configuration is host-resolved per authenticated connector account; provider code owns no tenant persistence or tenant selector.
Committed fixtures are synthetic; order projection excludes customer_id and delivery_region and API-key bytes exist only inside SecretAccessor callbacks.
Task 035 adds no public TORGNEXA HTTP endpoint or OpenAPI operation.
Task 035 publishes no new EventBus or webhook schema.
Task 035 reuses existing ProductReader, PriceReader, InventoryReader and OrderReader SDK-v1 capability surfaces without changing frozen Connector/Runtime roots.
Task 035 adds no migration; connector account, mapping, sync and reconciliation persistence already exist.

Provider code has no direct network/database/filesystem/process/Core/App authority. Fixed-host requests are host-mediated, API key is callback-scoped, bodies are bounded and raw remote/transport text is not disclosed.
Manifest grants only product/price/inventory/order reads; documented SKU/price/stock/order mutations are explicitly unsupported.
Remote reads do not directly mutate canonical state; subsequent sync application remains under existing audit/lineage rules.

product_id/sku_id/order_id/shop stock-type identities remain remote mapping/configuration keys; page/keyset/order cursors are configuration-bound and order cursors freeze the required created_at window.
Outbound Partner API calls use host-injected transport to fixed b2b-api.magnit.ru; no inbound webhook capability is granted.
Auth/rate/service outcomes normalize to bounded SDK health/errors; audited API lacks normative public request ceilings, so live ceilings remain staging/SLO evidence.
Suspend the connector account or remove the provider route to stop reads; no database rollback is required.

Synthetic/adversarial fixtures cover shop validation, SKU/product timestamp join, exact price keyset pagination, aggregate stock arithmetic, order-window pagination/privacy and bounded errors; canonical Task-064 provider report passes all thirteen checks.
